name: Characters Engine
author: ct
description: Engine characters subsystem: the character and action-card factories (entity kinds 'character' and 'action'), the avatar factory and the character panel UI. Replaces the former Core/Characters factories and Core/UI/CharacterPanel — the CharactersModInitializer publishes kernel contracts (ICharacterTemplateProvider, IActionTemplateProvider, IAvatarProvider) so core code resolves templates without referencing this assembly.
